'''Umbraspiders''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Spider/Legends|spider]] which produced silk that refracted and absorbed light in such a way that it was nearly invisible to the naked [[Eye/Legends|eye]] unless seen in bright light. The spiders used this silk to make webs; however, it was also harvested and used by members of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] species to produce [[Sakiyan shadowsuit]]s. The company [[Ayelixe/Krongbing Textiles/Legends|Ayelixe/Krongbing Textiles]] employed chemists to synthesize a material similar to the webbing known as [[shadowsilk]] which they also used to make [[shadowsuit]]s, but the Sakiyan's maintained that Umbraspider silk was superior to the synthetic material.<ref name="LONH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Umbraspiders were first created for ''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]'', a supplement book produced for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying game. The book was released in [[2015]] and was written by [[Max Brooke]] and [[Sterling Hershey]].
